Seed Module v2
A unified foundation distilled from your five “spine” docs

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Linkage Scaffold
SeedLayer:
  PrimaryTheme        -> informs FundamentalLaw
  ConceptualSeed      -> inspires SensoryLens
  ValueSpectrum       -> polarises CoreDuality (Axis 1)
                         and RelatedDuality (Axis 2)

Adapted directly from HTBU’s Seed-Law-Duality chain.

3 · Minimal YAML Schema (tool-friendly)
SeedModuleV2:
  version: 2.0
  PrimaryTheme:        # one-sentence essence
  ConceptualSeed:      # short paradox / image
  ValueSpectrum:       # "X ↔ Y"
  FundamentalLaw:      # single immutable principle
  SensoryLens:         # dominant sensory filter
  CoreDuality:         # Axis 1 (pole A / pole B)
  RelatedDuality:      # Axis 2 (pole C / pole D)

00_Design Language Format supplies the YAML skeleton.

Field order mirrors the linkage scaffold for easy validation.


4 · Usage Notes
Codex tone-guide – Encourage poetic phrasing (e.g., “An eternal dance of transformation”) when writers fill PrimaryTheme.

Archetype filters – Architect, Mirror, Weaver, Creator, Oracle docs do not redefine the seed; they reference it. When an archetype is active, prepend:
 SeedLens: Architect | Mirror | …
 so downstream modules can colour their output appropriately.


5 · Example (illustrative)
SeedModuleV2:
  PrimaryTheme: "All forms yearn toward their own reflection."
  ConceptualSeed: "In every mirror, a doorway."
  ValueSpectrum: "Clarity ↔ Obscurity"
  FundamentalLaw: "Reflection precedes manifestation."
  SensoryLens: "Perception of reality arrives first as echo, then object."
  CoreDuality: "Order / Flux"
  RelatedDuality: "Stasis / Becoming"



Audit · Step 02
Core Dualities + Fundamental Law
I compared only the five “spine” documents we agreed on—everything downstream just echoes them.
No conflicting terminology—all use “dualities/contrasts” and treat the Law as a single, overarching rule.

Duality & Law Module v2
1 · Canonical Lexicon
2 · Linkage Scaffold
SeedLayer.PrimaryTheme
   └─FundamentalLaw  (encodes the theme in universal rule-form)
        ├─CoreDuality        (Axis 1; poles resonate with ValueSpectrum)
        └─RelatedDuality     (Axis 2; complementary or orthogonal tension)

3 · YAML Schema Snippet
DualityLawModuleV2:
  FundamentalLaw:      # single declarative sentence
  CoreDuality:
    poleA:             # word/phrase
    poleB:             # word/phrase
  RelatedDuality:
    poleC:             # word/phrase
    poleD:             # word/phrase

4 · Implementation Notes
Immutability check – Any later content that tries to change FundamentalLaw must spawn a branch universe.

Echo rule – Each Step 03-08 module must reference at least one pole from Core or Related duality to maintain thematic coherence.

Archetype lenses – When an Archetype is active, it biases toward a pole (e.g., Mirror favours Flux), but never deletes the opposite.

5 · Example (matching the Seed example)
DualityLawModuleV2:
  FundamentalLaw: "Reflection precedes manifestation."
  CoreDuality:
    poleA: Clarity
    poleB: Obscurity
  RelatedDuality:
    poleC: Order
    poleD: Flux



Cosmic & Mythic Structures · Module v2
(synthesised from the five spine documents)

1 · Canonical Lexicon
The Codex contributes sample language such as “a slumbering sentience that pulses at the core of the universe” , while HTBU provides the template that ties cosmic constructs back to the Seed layer.

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)
(Names taken from the Abridged and 00_Narrative “Equilibrium / Interconnection” language.)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
SeedLayer.FundamentalLaw
    └─ CosmicForces      (instantiate the Law)
         ├─ MythicChronicles   (narrative memory)
         └─ DimensionalBoundaries
              ↪ feed into World & Geography module


5 · YAML Schema
CosmicMythicModuleV2:
  CosmicForces:
    - name:        # string
      aspect:      # abstract principle (e.g., “Entropy”)
      domain:      # realm or element governed
  CentralMyth:
    synopsis:      # paragraph
    keyEvents:     # list of pivotal moments
  DimensionalBoundaries:
    rules:         # short ruleset
    realmMap:      # optional nested list of planes


6 · Implementation Notes
Coherence check – Any new realm or deity must reference either CosmicForces.aspect or CentralMyth.keyEvents.

Duality echo – Where possible, pair opposing CosmicForces to the poles of Core / Related Dualities.

Tooling – 00_Narrative’s YAML-friendly naming (“CosmicPrinciple”) is mapped to CentralMyth.synopsis for backward compatibility.


7 · Example (continuing the running sample)
CosmicMythicModuleV2:
  CosmicForces:
    - name: Lucent    # clarity incarnation
      aspect: Clarity
      domain: Light & Memory
    - name: Umbral
      aspect: Obscurity
      domain: Shadow & Potential
  CentralMyth:
    synopsis: >
      From the Mirror of Origin, Lucent and Umbral emerged as twin reflections.
      Their dance birthed the first echo of space-time.
    keyEvents:
      - Shattering of the Mirror
      - Weaving of Realms
  DimensionalBoundaries:
    rules:
      - Reflection is required to cross realms.
      - Truth cannot pass untouched.
    realmMap:
      - Plane of Echoes
      - The Liminal Verge

World & Geography · Module v2
(synthesised from “03 World,” HTBU world templates, Codex context section, and 00_Narrative schema)

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
CosmicMythicModuleV2.CentralMyth
       └─ MythicToponym ↦ places
            ├─ BiomeSignature  (inherits CosmicForces aspects)
            └─ ResourceNode
                 ↪ feeds Social/Economic Systems module


5 · YAML Schema
WorldGeoModuleV2:
  ContinentalMasses:
    - name:
      mythicToponym:      # optional etymology note
      biomeSignature:
        type:             # desert, crystal-reef, etc.
        climaticGradient: # description or numeric range
      resourceNodes:
        - type:           # iron, dreamstone, data-wells
          abundance:      # high / medium / low
  GlobalPatterns:
    prevailingWinds:      # short description
    leyLines:             # optional magical currents
    migratoryRoutes:      # list of major paths


6 · Implementation Notes
Duality Echo – At least one ContinentalMass should physically embody CoreDuality poles (e.g., luminous plains vs. shadow coast).

Scalability – New regions must declare biomeSignature.type and reference which CosmicForce or Duality pole they resonate with.

Map Hook – A simple coordinate or hex-grid index can be added for GIS / MythOS UI.


7 · Example (continuing sample)
WorldGeoModuleV2:
  ContinentalMasses:
    - name: Lustram
      mythicToponym: "Land of First Light"
      biomeSignature:
        type: Glass-meadow Steppe
        climaticGradient: "Temperate → Arid toward the Obsidian Verge"
      resourceNodes:
        - type: MemoryQuartz
          abundance: high
    - name: Umbrafen
      mythicToponym: "Shadow-Reclaimed Marsh"
      biomeSignature:
        type: Bioluminescent Bog
        climaticGradient: "Humid — constant phosphor mist"
      resourceNodes:
        - type: Echo-Reeds
          abundance: medium
  GlobalPatterns:
    prevailingWinds: "East-to-west Zephyr carrying reflection spores"
    leyLines: "Tri-spoked lattice converging beneath the Mirror Rift"
    migratoryRoutes:
      - "Lucent Herd spiral path across Lustram"




Culture & Civilisation · Module v2
(synthesised from “04 Cultural & Civilisational,” HTBU cultural matrices, Codex social-dynamics section, and 00 Narrative schema)

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
WorldGeoModuleV2.ContinentalMasses
    └─ EthnoStrata
         ├─ ValueAxisCulture (mirrors Core / Related Dualities)
         ├─ RitualNodes      (inherit CosmicForces symbolism)
         └─ AestheticMemes   (reflect BiomeSignature & resources)


5 · YAML Schema
CultureCivModuleV2:
  civilisations:
    - name:
      ethnoStrata:
        - id:
          valueAxisCulture:     # e.g., "Clarity-pursuit collectivism"
          populationEstimate:
          linguisticFamily:
          aestheticMemes:       # list
          ritualNodes:
            - name:
              cadence:          # daily / seasonal / life-milestone
              mythicReference:  # link to CentralMyth
  exchangeNetwork:
    tradeRoutes:               # list of pairs or paths
    pilgrimageWays:
    infoCircuits:              # couriers, crystal-nets, etc.


6 · Implementation Notes
Duality Echo – At least one EthnoStratum per civilised region should lean to each pole of Core or Related Duality, maintaining thematic balance.

Resource Logic – A RitualNode that consumes scarce resources must reference its corresponding resourceNode.abundance.

Versioning – When an EthnoStratum evolves, append generationTag (e.g., v1, v2) rather than overwrite, to retain historical layering.


7 · Example (continuing sample)
CultureCivModuleV2:
  civilisations:
    - name: Luminar Concord
      ethnoStrata:
        - id: SolarArtisans
          valueAxisCulture: "Clarity-oriented individual mastery"
          populationEstimate: 1.2M
          linguisticFamily: "Heliatic"
          aestheticMemes: ["glass-filigree motifs", "sun-chime scales"]
          ritualNodes:
            - name: Dawn-Mirror Rite
              cadence: daily
              mythicReference: "First Light’s reflection"
        - id: Glyph-Keepers
          valueAxisCulture: "Obscurity-embracing archivism"
          populationEstimate: 450k
          linguisticFamily: "Heliatic-Low"
          aestheticMemes: ["ink-veiled script", "shadow-calligraphy"]
          ritualNodes:
            - name: Nocturne Scriptorium
              cadence: seasonal
              mythicReference: "Second Shattering"
  exchangeNetwork:
    tradeRoutes: ["Luminar ↔ Umbrafen (Quartz caravans)"]
    pilgrimageWays: ["Mirror Rift spiral"]
    infoCircuits: ["Echo-Reed whisper relays"]



Socio-Political & Economic Systems · Module v2
(synthesised from “05 Political, Social & Economic,” HTBU “Systems & Structures,” and governance sections in the Codex and 00 Narrative schema)

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
CultureCivModuleV2.civilisations.ethnoStrata
    └─ SocialStrata
         ├─ PowerMatrix (formal + informal)
         ├─ EconomyMode  (drives ResourceNode flow)
         └─ ConflictValve (mediates ValueAxis tensions)


5 · YAML Schema
SocioPolEconModuleV2:
  polities:
    - name:
      powerMatrix:
        governmentType:       # council, empire, technocracy, etc.
        informalBlocs:        # guilds, secret orders
      economyMode:
        primary:              # gift / market / command / ritual
        keyCommodities:       # list of ResourceNode types
      socialStrata:
        - tier:
          basis:              # birth / merit / ritual mark
          mobilityRules:
      ethicCodes:
        - principle:
          sourceMythicEvent:
      conflictValves:
        - type:               # duel, debate, omens
          escalationLimit:    # how far conflict may go
  interPolityRelations:
    alliances:                # list of pairs
    rivalries:
    tradeAgreements:


6 · Implementation Notes
Duality echo – Highest and lowest SocialStrata often align to opposite poles of CoreDuality.

Consistency check – Any EconomyMode must reference a ResourceNode from WorldGeoModule.

Dynamic hook – When ResourceNode abundance changes, flag economyMode.adjustmentNeeded: true for iterative update cycles.


7 · Example (continuing sample)
SocioPolEconModuleV2:
  polities:
    - name: Luminar Concord
      powerMatrix:
        governmentType: Council of Refractions
        informalBlocs: ["SolarArtisan Guild", "Glyph-Keeper Archivists"]
      economyMode:
        primary: market
        keyCommodities: ["MemoryQuartz", "Echo-Reeds"]
      socialStrata:
        - tier: Radiant
          basis: mastery of light-craft
          mobilityRules: apprenticeship & merit trials
        - tier: Shadowbound
          basis: birth into archival families
          mobilityRules: can ascend via Mirror-Trial
      ethicCodes:
        - principle: "Illumination through service"
          sourceMythicEvent: "First Light’s reflection"
      conflictValves:
        - type: Dawn Duel
          escalationLimit: “first blood”
  interPolityRelations:
    alliances: ["Luminar Concord ↔ Glyph-Keepers"]
    rivalries: ["Luminar Concord ↔ Umbrafen Marsh-Lords"]
    tradeAgreements: ["Quartz-for-Reeds caravan pact"]




Technology & Magic Frameworks · Module v2
(drawn from “06 Technological & Magical,” HTBU tech-magic templates, Codex tool-of-power section, and 00 Narrative schema)
1 · Canonical Lexicon
2 · Core Patterns
3 · Master Key
4 · Linkage Scaffold
ResourceNodes → PowerSources
       └─ TechDomain / MagicParadigm
             └─ ConstraintLaw (ties back to EthicCodes)

5 · YAML Schema
TechMagicModuleV2:
  powerSources:
    - id:
      type: natural / synthetic / metaphysical
      abundance: high/medium/low
      constraintLaw:
  techDomains:
    - name:
      coreFunction:
      powerSourceRef:
      keyDevices:        # list
  magicParadigms:
    - name:
      doctrine:
      powerSourceRef:
      signatureRites:    # list
  synergyCircuits:
    - techDomainRef:
      magicParadigmRef:
      emergentEffect:

6 · Implementation Notes
Balance test – Any SynergyCircuit must include at least one complementary Duality pole.

Escalation guard – If ConstraintLaw is broken, flag downstream modules for systemic instability.

Versioning – Each paradigm/device can add rev: tags (v1, v2…) tying into Step 09 future-proofing.

7 · Example (continuing sample)
TechMagicModuleV2:
  powerSources:
    - id: ReflectionFlux
      type: metaphysical
      abundance: medium
      constraintLaw: "Flux destabilises beyond the Mirror Rift"
  techDomains:
    - name: Luminal Engrams
      coreFunction: memory-imprint crystal recorders
      powerSourceRef: ReflectionFlux
      keyDevices: ["Engram Glass", "Echo-Stylus"]
  magicParadigms:
    - name: Mirror-Runecraft
      doctrine: carve sigils that redirect ReflectionFlux
      powerSourceRef: ReflectionFlux
      signatureRites: ["Shatter-Seal", "Echo-Bind"]
  synergyCircuits:
    - techDomainRef: Luminal Engrams
      magicParadigmRef: Mirror-Runecraft
      emergentEffect: "Self-updating sentient archives"



Fine-Grained Cultural Details · Module v2
(synthesised from “07 Fine-Grained Cultural Details,” HTBU culture-detail templates, and Abridged pattern lexicon)
1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
CultureCivModuleV2.ethnoStrata
    └─ FineDetails
         ├─ Foodways
         ├─ IdiomShards / MicroRituals
         └─ SymbolicArtifacts / FolkArtForms


5 · YAML Schema
FineDetailModuleV2:
  ethnoDetails:
    - ethnoStratumRef:
      foodways:
        - name:
          occasion: daily / festival / lifecycle
          keyIngredients:
      idiomShards:
        - phrase:
          meaning:
      microRituals:
        - name:
          trigger: greeting / farewell / threshold
          symbolicLink:
      folkArtForms:
        - type: textile / song / dance / tattoo
          motif:                # pattern or colour family
      symbolicArtifacts:
        - item:
          significance:
          materialOrigin:


6 · Implementation Notes
Duality Echo – Idioms and micro-rituals should lean toward Clarity or Obscurity, Order or Flux, etc.

Sensory Consistency – motif colours or sounds should align with BiomeSignature & AestheticMemes.

Version Tags – When traditions evolve, append era: or rev: to preserve layered heritage.


7 · Example (continuing sample)
FineDetailModuleV2:
  ethnoDetails:
    - ethnoStratumRef: SolarArtisans
      foodways:
        - name: Prism-Broth
          occasion: festival
          keyIngredients: ["quartz-infused water", "sun-herbs"]
      idiomShards:
        - phrase: "Catch the first glint"
          meaning: "Seize opportunity at dawn"
      microRituals:
        - name: Dawn-Palm Salute
          trigger: greeting
          symbolicLink: "First Light"
      folkArtForms:
        - type: glass-filigree carving
          motif: "radiant spiral"
      symbolicArtifacts:
        - item: Sun-Chime
          significance: wards off reflective echoes
          materialOrigin: MemoryQuartz



Characters & Local Stories · Module v2
(drawn from “08 Individual Characters & Local Stories,” Abridged lexicon, and character sections within HTBU and Codex)

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
CultureCivModuleV2.ethnoStrata
        └─ Characters
             ├─ ContrastsOfPersona  (align Core/Related Dualities)
             ├─ PersonalEcho        (mirrors PrimaryTheme)
             └─ ArtifactOfMemory    (ties to RitualNodes or SymbolicArtifacts)


5 · YAML Schema
CharacterStoryModuleV2:
  characters:
    - id:
      name:
      ethnoStratumRef:
      role: protagonist / deuteragonist / foil / mentor
      contrastsOfPersona:
        poleInner:        # e.g., Clarity-seeking
        poleShadow:       # e.g., Fear of Obscurity
      personalEcho:        # one-sentence theme reflection
      artifactOfMemory:
        item:
        origin:
        thematicLink:
      microTales:
        - title:
          synopsis:
          actHook:        # inciting / midpoint / resolution
  relationshipWeb:
    - charA:
      charB:
      bondType: ally / rival / kin / mentor
      tensionAxis: CoreDuality / RelatedDuality


6 · Implementation Notes
Duality check – Each contrastsOfPersona must point explicitly to Core or Related Duality poles.

Theme thread – personalEcho phrasing should reuse PrimaryTheme vocabulary to keep resonance obvious.

Version tags – When a character re-enters in a later timeline, add era: and leave prior YAML intact for lineage tracking.


7 · Example (continuing sample universe)
CharacterStoryModuleV2:
  characters:
    - id: Lira_Splitglass
      name: "Lira Split-glass"
      ethnoStratumRef: SolarArtisans
      role: protagonist
      contrastsOfPersona:
        poleInner: drive for pure Clarity
        poleShadow: fascination with Obscurity
      personalEcho: "She polishes every mirror until it fractures."
      artifactOfMemory:
        item: Shard-loom Pendant
        origin: crafted from the First Mirror splinter
        thematicLink: Reflection precedes manifestation
      microTales:
        - title: “The Echo Thief”
          synopsis: Lira bargains with a shadow-broker to retrieve stolen memories.
          actHook: inciting
  relationshipWeb:
    - charA: Lira_Splitglass
      charB: Archivist_Kai
      bondType: ally
      tensionAxis: CoreDuality



Future-Proofing & Iteration · Module v2
(core source: 09_Future_Design, plus iterative passages in HTBU and Codex)

1 · Canonical Lexicon

2 · Core Patterns

3 · Master Key (Integrators)

4 · Linkage Scaffold
AllModules.*
    └─ ModularNode (has unique ID)
         └─ ChangelogEntry (when modified)
              └─ VersionControl.repo
                   ↔ FeedbackLoop inputs
                       ↪ may trigger EvolutionBranch if FundamentalLaw broken


5 · YAML Schema
FutureIterationModuleV2:
  versionControl:
    repoURL:
    latestTag:
    changelog:
      - id:
        timestamp:
        editor:
        affectedNodes: [ids]
        summary:
        reason:
  feedbackLoop:
    channels:  # forum / survey / oracle-dream net
    reviewCycle:  # quarterly / annual
    triageRules:
  modularNodes:
    - id:
      moduleRef: Seed / Duality / Cosmic / etc.
      status: active / deprecated / branched
      lineage: parentID
  evolutionBranches:
    - branchID:
      triggerEvent: FundamentalLaw breach / player-vote / AI-analysis
      divergenceSummary:
  scheduledReviews:
    - date:
      scope: thematic / balance / factual


6 · Implementation Notes
Immutable guard – Attempting to edit PrimaryTheme or FundamentalLaw must create an evolutionBranches entry instead of overwriting.

Impact matrix – Each ChangelogEntry should list downstream nodes to update; MythOS can automate dependency checks.

Transparency – Publish summaries to community channels to keep collaborative trust high.


7 · Example (continuing sample)
FutureIterationModuleV2:
  versionControl:
    repoURL: "git://mirrorforge.univ"
    latestTag: v0.9.2
    changelog:
      - id: CL-042
        timestamp: 2025-05-21
        editor: "DawnWeaver"
        affectedNodes: [LuminalEngrams, Mirror-Runecraft]
        summary: "Refined ConstraintLaw wording"
        reason: "Player exploit created infinite Flux loop"
  feedbackLoop:
    channels: ["Echo-Forum", "Crystal Polls"]
    reviewCycle: "bi-annual"
    triageRules: "Urgent if exploits break ConstraintLaw"
  modularNodes:
    - id: Mirror-Runecraft
      moduleRef: magicParadigms
      status: active
      lineage: root
  evolutionBranches:
    - branchID: EB-001
      triggerEvent: FundamentalLaw breach (ReflectionFlux overflow)
      divergenceSummary: "Shadow-Dominant Timeline"
  scheduledReviews:
    - date: 2026-01-01
      scope: thematic
